technical_smoke: One duplicate scenario/seed validation is kept in experiment smoke_result.json and excluded from formal estimates.
cohort: Four fixed scenarios,56 reused benchmark seeds,7 controllers; no refit,labelcollection,parameterselection or replacement seeds.
primary_estimand: Within-city/seed relative waiting changes, average3Jinan scenarios first, equal-average2cities, then56seeds.
multiplicity: six comparators times three scopes; wilcoxon_p_holm_expanded18 is the current manuscript correction. Historical Holm12/15 columns remain historical.
original_execution_counters: execution_rollouts.csv has1344originalrun counters, including896 learned-policy guard audits. Missing pressure guard fields mean not applicable.
new_reference_counters: seven_controller_rollouts.csv contains the224 exact-reference request counts; no learned guard audit applies.

outcome_fields.system_vehicle_hours: Active plus pending vehicle-seconds in [60,3600],divided by3600.
outcome_fields.completion_ratio: Cumulative arrivals/(cumulative departures+pending insertion at endpoint),fraction.
outcome_fields.collision_events: Raw collision records returned by SUMO getCollisions(),summed over steps.
outcome_fields.collision_event_steps: Simulation steps with at least one collision record.

source_binding: Original code and experiment records:GitHub commit12e7955d0350e4cac2a344d04954cfb5efea70a2; new records, code and traces are in the accompanying versioned source archive.
